newsitem.title: INDIA: Bus plunges into India river, 27 dead.
newsitem.headline: Bus plunges into India river, 27 dead.

text.p: Twenty-seven people drowned and 28 were injured on Saturday when a bus crashed through a guard rail and plunged into a rain-swollen river in northern India, United News of India said.
The news agency said the bus, carrying 55 passengers, toppled into the river in Uttar Pradesh state's Lalitpur district.
It said the bodies of all the passengers had been recovered. The news agency gave no other details.
